propositions: Plan review operations that return PASS verdict must sign and persist a plan-review attestation by default on all mutating public routes (CLI and library)
Explicit unsigned execution requires deliberate opt-out: --no-sign flag for CLI, sign=False parameter for library; omission of these flags must trigger signing
Non-signable verdicts (BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded) and failed signature persistence must never produce a signed attestation and must return retryable failure disposition
Idempotent re-run of a plan review with current claim-valid attestation must reuse the existing attestation without triggering a new LLM call or duplicate signature event
CLI help and documentation must accurately describe sign-on-PASS default, explicit opt-out syntax, non-signable outcomes, and sign-review recovery path
